newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST - Alfa Q3 results seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Alfa Q3 results seen mixed.

text.p: Mexican industrial conglomerate Alfa should report lower total sales in the third quarter, but analysts estimate higher net profit as a result of greater efficiency.
A survey of three industry analysts predicted per share earnings of 1.61 pesos in the period from July to September.

"(Alfa) is improving its margins as a result of efforts to make its processes more efficient and begin plant operations," said Carlos Ponce, director of analysis at Santander Investment in Mexico City.
